description: This file defines the UploadedFile class implementing the UploadedFileInterface, handling uploaded file data including error states, file streams, and move operations within the GuzzleHttp PSR7 package.

classes.name: UploadedFile
classes.description: A class representing an uploaded file, providing methods to access file properties, move the file, and handle upload errors.

methods.name: __construct
methods.description: Constructor initializing the uploaded file object with stream or filename, size, error status, and optional client filename and media type.

methods.name: setStreamOrFile
methods.description: Sets the internal stream or filename based on the input, validating the type.

methods.name: setError
methods.description: Validates and sets the upload error status.

methods.name: setSize
methods.description: Validates and sets the file size.

methods.name: isStringOrNull
methods.description: Checks if a parameter is a string or null.

methods.name: isStringNotEmpty
methods.description: Checks if a string parameter is not empty.

methods.name: setClientFilename
methods.description: Sets the client filename after validation.

methods.name: setClientMediaType
methods.description: Sets the client media type after validation.

methods.name: isOk
methods.description: Returns true if there is no upload error.

methods.name: isMoved
methods.description: Checks if the file has been moved.

methods.name: validateActive
methods.description: Ensures the file is in a valid state for operations, throwing exceptions if not.

methods.name: getStream
methods.description: Returns the stream of the uploaded file, or opens it if only filename is available.

methods.name: moveTo
methods.description: Moves the uploaded file to a specified target path, handling different environments and errors.

methods.name: getSize
methods.description: Returns the size of the uploaded file.

methods.name: getClientFilename
methods.description: Returns the filename sent by the client.

methods.name: getClientMediaType
methods.description: Returns the media type sent by the client.
